raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Since #45421, the DSpark eager accept path skips the sampling accept (draft/target softmax + rejection) whenever `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN` is set, on CUDA as well as HIP, with no way to turn it off. Simulated-acceptance benchmarks should keep the real sampling-accept cost by default, so their numbers are not lower-bounded by skipped work.

## Modifications

- Add `SGLANG_ENABLE_DSPARK_SIMULATE_SKIP_SAMPLING = EnvBool(False)` in `environ.py`, next to the other DSpark simulation knobs.
- In `TargetVerifyExecutor.accept_and_finalize`, skip the sampling accept only when simulated acceptance is active **and** this flag is set. Default behavior now runs the sampling accept and then applies the simulated `correct_len`, as before #45421 on CUDA.
- `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_GREEDY` and `SGLANG_DSPARK_SIMULATE_FOLD` already default to `False`; unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

No change to model outputs: with simulated acceptance, `correct_len` is overwritten by the simulation either way; without simulated acceptance, this code path is unchanged.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Default simulated-acceptance runs regain the sampling-accept cost that #45421 removed; runs that want the old behavior set `SGLANG_ENABLE_DSPARK_SIMULATE_SKIP_SAMPLING=1`.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

nodes.body:
Makes sense to keep the real cost by default. One side effect worth a line in the description: greedy_bonus a few lines down still keys on accept_sampling_info, so with the flag off a sampled batch under SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN now syncs at DSPARK_ACCEPT_SAMPLE instead of DSPARK_ACCEPT_GREEDY. That matches a real run, which I think is the point, but people comparing benchmark numbers will notice.

Small nit: the neighbors are SGLANG_DSPARK_SIMULATE_FOLD and SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_GREEDY, so SGLANG_DSPARK_SIMULATE_SKIP_SAMPLING would read more like the rest.

Closing: superseded by #46840, which makes the DSpark eager accept run the real accept for both greedy and sampling batches under simulated acceptance (and trims the simulated bonus to one row), so this opt-in flag is no longer needed. Thanks @nvpohanh and @paolo-perrone for the reviews.

[by Claude Code] This review is done by agents. Please feel free to disagree if they do not make sense.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: style | Confidence: High**

**Issue**

The Speed Tests section has no numbers. It says default simulated runs "regain the sampling-accept cost", but does not show how large that cost is. This change makes every DSpark simulated-acceptance run with sampled requests slower by default, so people comparing benchmark numbers across this commit need the size of the shift.

**Fix**

Add one before/after result of the same measurement, such as decode step time or tok/s/user with `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN` set, and name the model and GPU. Use sampled requests (temperature > 0); greedy requests do not take this path, so a greedy run would show no change.

[by Claude Code] **Severity: functional | Confidence: Medium**

**Issue**

The new flag only works in `accept_and_finalize`. With `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH=1`, all-sampled static steps use `DsparkSamplingAcceptGraph` instead, and its `sampling_accept_commit_lens` always runs the sampling accept (softmax + rejection) under `SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN`. The `environ.py` comment does not mention this limit.

**Example**

The DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash AgentX recipe sets `SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_SAMPLING_ACCEPT_GRAPH=1`. A simulated run with temperature > 0 and this flag set still pays the sampling-accept cost on those steps.

**Fix**

Read the flag once at init, like `simulate_fold`, and pass `sampling_info=None` to `accept_draft_tokens` in `sampling_accept_commit_lens` when it is set; that region already takes the bonus from `epilogue.sim_bonus`. Or say in the `environ.py` comment that the flag covers only the eager accept.

files.patch:
@@ -533,6 +533,9 @@ class Envs:
     # DSpark opt-in: apply the simulated correct_len / bonus inside the folded verify epilogue
     # (CUDA/HIP graph) instead of falling back to the eager accept + commit path.
     SGLANG_DSPARK_SIMULATE_FOLD = EnvBool(False)
+    # DSpark opt-in: with SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN set, skip the sampling accept (draft/target
+    # softmax + rejection) whose correct_len the simulation overwrites anyway.
+    SGLANG_ENABLE_DSPARK_SIMULATE_SKIP_SAMPLING = EnvBool(False)
     SGLANG_SIMULATE_UNIFORM_EXPERTS = EnvBool(False)
     SGLANG_SIMULATE_ROUND_ROBIN_EXPERTS = EnvBool(False)

@@ -200,9 +200,12 @@ def accept_and_finalize(
             return self.verify_epilogue.read_accept(bs)
 
         simulate = self._simulated_correct_len is not None
-        # Simulated acceptance overwrites correct_len below, so a sampling accept
-        # (draft/target softmax + rejection) would be computed only to be discarded.
-        accept_sampling_info = None if simulate else sampling_info
+        # Simulated acceptance overwrites correct_len below; skipping the sampling
+        # accept (draft/target softmax + rejection) is opt-in so default runs keep its cost.
+        skip_accept_sampling = (
+            simulate and envs.SGLANG_ENABLE_DSPARK_SIMULATE_SKIP_SAMPLING.get()
+        )
+        accept_sampling_info = None if skip_accept_sampling else sampling_info
         correct_len, bonus, cap_trim_lens = accept_draft_tokens(
             candidates=verify_ids_2d,
             target_logits=target_logits,
